stable_description: Invite people to this list and optionally include current and future nested lists.
share_all_nested_description: Includes current nested lists and lists added or moved here later. Leave this off to share only this list.
expired_help: Ask the list owner to resend this invitation to renew it for 30 days.
invitation_delivery_failed: Invitation created, but the email was not sent. You can resend it later.
remove_confirmation: Remove {{name}} from this shared list? Bookmark entries they contributed through this collaboration will be removed from this shared list, but their underlying bookmarks will remain in their library.
